The following events took place in '''8 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] invaded [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]]. The [[Contruum rebellion]] began.<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] earned the nickname "Slick" from [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Alexsandr Badure]] when he safely landed a malfunctioning [[U-33 orbital loadlifter]].
*[[Venthan Chassu/Legends|Venthan Chassu's]] [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] nudes were displayed in the [[Museum of Fine Art|Coronet City Museum of Fine Art]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
*[[Eib]] sold [[Gryseium Incorporated]] to [[Rigis Corazon]].
*The [[Mecetti]] government nationalized its key industries.
*The [[Pan-Tapani Historical Society]] was formed.
*[[Mako Spince]] stole a gram of [[antimatter]] and tried to use it to blow the seal off the [[Mascot Moon]] of [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] as a prank. He accidentally destroyed the whole [[Moon/Legends|moon]] and was expelled as a result.
*Imperial [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] gave up the mediations of the [[South Cont's civil war]].<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>
